heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 7030136:2213.Jan. 8, 1983, Pub. L. 97–427, § 14, 96 Stat. 2267. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possessions of the United States”.
